verdict.rationale: Square hosts a live llms.txt (probe-confirmed HTTP 200) explicitly declaring the docs 'Designed to be consumable by both human developers and AI agents,' with per-agent guidance (idempotency keys, cursor pagination) and a pointer to a full corpus at llms-full.txt, plus markdown-rendered docs via .md suffix. missing for 10: independent third-party confirmation that agents actually consume/act on llms.txt successfully in the wild, and docs.md/openapi endpoints 404 rather than being available as alternate agent-friendly formats.
